items.title: Nvidia board probes CEO Huang's ties to alleged Chinese spy
items.summary: Nvidia's board opened an investigation after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. A governance and security cloud over the CEO is a real risk given Nvidia's sensitivity to U.S.-China export policy.

items.title: Palantir revenue nearly doubles; full-year outlook raised again
items.summary: Q3 revenue rose 96% to $2.31B and U.S. commercial revenue jumped 148%, overtaking U.S. government sales for the first time. Palantir lifted full-year revenue guidance to about $8.53B.

items.title: AMD data center sales nearly double, guidance tops estimates
items.summary: AMD's data center revenue nearly doubled in Q3 and it forecast next-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations, with CEO Lisa Su expecting growth to accelerate further.

items.title: Constellation lands 20-year nuclear power deals with Google and Amazon
items.summary: Constellation signed a ~890 MW, 20-year nuclear PPA with Google and a 690 MW, 20-year deal with Amazon for Calvert Cliffs, and raised its 2026 EPS guidance to $12.50-12.80. Locks in long-term contracted demand from hyperscalers.

items.title: Arista posts fastest growth since IPO on AI networking
items.summary: Q3 revenue grew 58.5% to $3.66B, beating its own $3.3B guide, and Q4 guidance of $3.9-4.0B points to continued AI data center demand.

items.title: AppLovin revenue up 55% with 84% EBITDA margin; buyback expanded
items.summary: Q3 revenue rose 55% to $2.19B and adjusted EBITDA margin hit 84%. AppLovin guided Q4 higher and added $3.2B to its buyback authorization.

items.title: Rocket Lab hits record revenue and backlog, but Neutron slips to 2027
items.summary: Q3 revenue rose 73% to a record $268M and backlog grew 52% in a quarter to about $3.6B. However, the first Neutron launch is now targeted no earlier than 2027, delaying its medium-lift ambitions.

items.title: IonQ revenue quadruples and full-year outlook raised
items.summary: Q3 revenue jumped 336% to $174M, remaining performance obligations doubled to $1.2B, and 2026 revenue guidance rose to $505-515M. The SkyWater foundry acquisition has closed, adding manufacturing revenue.

items.title: Datadog grows 35% with large-customer count up 20%
items.summary: Q3 revenue rose 35% to $1.2B with a 21% free cash flow margin, and customers paying $100K+ a year grew 20% to about 4,860, signaling steady enterprise demand for observability.
